description: This file contains utility functions and classes related to distributed tensor operations within PyTorch, including collective communication methods (scatter, broadcast, alltoall), tensor padding, metadata checking, and cost estimation for communication and placements in distributed mesh topologies.

classes.name: MeshTopoInfo
classes.description: Class holding topology information for device mesh used in collective cost estimation, including methods to build cache-aware info from a mesh.

methods.name: _shard_dim_alltoall_meta(input, gather_dim, shard_dim, group_name)
methods.description: Meta registration method that returns a tensor representing the alltoall operation for a specific shard dimension, constructing it via concatenation and chunking.

methods.name: shard_dim_alltoall(input, gather_dim, shard_dim, mesh, mesh_dim)
methods.description: Performs a shard-dimensional all-to-all operation, with fallback implementation for CPU using allgather and chunk.

methods.name: Work|None mesh_scatter( output: torch.Tensor, scatter_list: list[torch.Tensor], mesh: DeviceMesh, mesh_dim: int = 0, async_op: bool = False, *, group_src: int = 0, )
methods.description: Distributes a list of tensors across a device mesh along a specified dimension, optionally as an asynchronous operation.

methods.name: Work|None mesh_broadcast( tensor: torch.Tensor, mesh: DeviceMesh, mesh_dim: int = 0, async_op: bool = False, *, group_src: int = 0, )
methods.description: Broadcasts a tensor across a device mesh along a specified dimension.

methods.name: torch.Tensor pad_tensor(tensor: torch.Tensor, pad_dim: int, pad_size: int)
methods.description: Pads a tensor along a specified dimension.

methods.name: torch.Tensor unpad_tensor(tensor: torch.Tensor, pad_dim: int, pad_size: int)
methods.description: Removes padding from a tensor along a specified dimension.

methods.name: list[torch.Tensor] fill_empty_tensor_to_shards( shards: list[torch.Tensor], shard_dim: int, num_empty_tensors: int )
methods.description: Extends a list of tensor shards with empty tensors to match a specified number of tensors.

methods.name: Optional["dtensor_spec.TensorMeta"] check_tensor_meta( local_tensor, check_shape_stride=False )
methods.description: Checks for consistent tensor metadata (dtype, shape, stride) across distributed ranks.

methods.name: int spec_to_bytes(spec: "dtensor_spec.DTensorSpec")
methods.description: Calculates the byte size of a tensor spec based on its metadata.

methods.name: MeshTopoInfo.build_from_mesh
methods.description: Creates cached topology information for a device mesh, estimating bandwidth and latency per dimension.

methods.name: float allgather_cost(bytes_gb: float, mesh_topo: MeshTopoInfo, mesh_dim: int)
methods.description: Estimates the communication cost of an allgather operation over a specific mesh dimension.

methods.name: float allreduce_cost(bytes_gb: float, mesh_topo: MeshTopoInfo, mesh_dim: int)
methods.description: Estimates the communication cost of an allreduce operation over a specific mesh dimension.

methods.name: float reduce_scatter_cost( bytes_gb: float, mesh_topo: MeshTopoInfo, mesh_dim: int, )
methods.description: Estimates the communication cost of a reduce-scatter operation along a mesh dimension.

methods.name: tuple[float,float] _compute_placement_transition_cost( current_placement: "dtensor_spec.Placement", target_placement: "dtensor_spec.Placement", mesh_topo: MeshTopoInfo, mesh_dim: int, comm_bytes_gb: float, )
methods.description: Computes the communication cost of transitioning from one placement to another within a mesh dimension.

methods.name: float one_step_redistribute_cost( current_spec: "dtensor_spec.DTensorSpec", target_spec: "dtensor_spec.DTensorSpec", )
methods.description: Calculates the cost of a single redistribution step between two tensor specifications.

methods.name: float redistribute_cost( current_spec: "dtensor_spec.DTensorSpec", target_spec: "dtensor_spec.DTensorSpec", )
methods.description: Calculates the total communication cost to redistribute from one tensor spec to another, considering the entire transformation path.
